response.sql: WITH s AS (SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) AS a FROM telescopes WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL GROUP BY observstation), g AS (SELECT AVG(bandusagepct) AS g FROM telescopes WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL) SELECT AVG(s.a) AS mean_usage, AVG(s.a - g.g) AS mean_excess FROM s, g WHERE s.a > g.g

assumptions.assumption: The 'average' used as the benchmark is the overall mean bandwidth usage across all telescopes with non-null values. Each station's average is compared against it.
The mean usage is the mean of the qualifying stations' own average usage, so each station counts equally. The excess is each station's average minus the benchmark, averaged over those stations.

alternatives.interpretation: The benchmark is the mean of the station-level averages, so each station counts equally, rather than the mean across all telescopes.
alternatives.sql: WITH s AS (SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) AS a FROM telescopes WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL GROUP BY observstation), g AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS g FROM s) SELECT AVG(s.a) AS mean_usage, AVG(s.a - g.g) AS mean_excess FROM s, g WHERE s.a > g.g
